plugins.name: nuxt
plugins.description: Nuxt development guidance with Vue best practices, auto-imports awareness, and library-specific patterns for Pinia, VueUse, and more

plugins.name: video-to-article
plugins.description: Convert lecture videos to transcripts, outlines, and article drafts using automated workflow with ffmpeg and ElevenLabs API

plugins.name: dev-azdo
plugins.description: Azure DevOps workflow automation as NL-driven skills: ticket (show, create, comment, state), pr, pr-comments, feature-branch. Work items and comments are created via az rest so descriptions render as Markdown.

plugins.name: confluence
plugins.description: Atlassian MCP server for Confluence, plus a `wiki-map` skill holding a pre-built map of the connected site — live spaces, the subtrees that actually get edited, direct links — and the recipe to regenerate it.

plugins.name: cc
plugins.description: Claude Code authoring tools: create plugins, skills, commands, and introspect Claude Code internals

plugins.name: aiwork
plugins.description: Standardizes .aiwork/ artifact organization by task (aiwork-protocol skill), with skills for the full loop: intent → spec → tickets → implement → review (triage, to-spec, to-tickets, implement, implement-spec, next-steps, code-review-diff, grill-with-docs, tdd, prototype, wait-what)

plugins.name: browser
plugins.description: Browser automation for agents on top of the playwright-cli CLI (@playwright/cli): playwright-cli (official skill, vendored), showme (hand the user a headed window in a given state), page-bridge (feedback toolbar on a dev page), pick (one-shot element picker)

plugins.name: writing
plugins.description: Writing skills: wr (clear English prose rules plus a heuristic prose linter), fix-grammar (typos and syntax only), tldr (distill the last answer), czech-typography (Czech typography for the web)

plugins.name: maintenance
plugins.description: Repository upkeep skills: docs-checker (audit context files for broken references and stale content) and dependency-update (one reviewable dependency PR per run, with a deterministic scan script)
